questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence with reported speech.
He said, 'I am happy.'
options: He said he was happy.
He said he is happy.
He said, 'I am happy.'
He said that he is happy.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the statement?
She said, 'I have finished my homework.'
options: She said she finished her homework.
She said she has finished her homework.
She said that she had finished her homework.
She said, 'I have finished my homework.'
questions.answer: She said that she had finished her homework.

questions.question:
Select the correct reported form.
He said to me, 'Don't forget to call me.'
options: He told me not to forget to call him.
He said to me not to forget to call him.
He told me to not forget to call him.
He said, 'Don't forget to call me.'
questions.answer: He told me not to forget to call him.

questions.question:
Which option correctly reports the question?
She asked me, 'What time does the train leave?'
options: She asked me what time did the train leave.
She asked me what time the train left.
She asked me what time the train leaves.
She asked me what time the train would leave.
questions.answer: She asked me what time the train would leave.

questions.question:
Choose the correct reported speech.
He said, 'I have been to Paris three times.'
options: He said he has been to Paris three times.
He said he had been to Paris three times.
He said he was to Paris three times.
He said he goes to Paris three times.
questions.answer: He said he had been to Paris three times.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the passive voice?
This book was written by a famous author in 1999.
options: This book was written by a famous author in 1999.
This book has been written by a famous author in 1999.
This book were written by a famous author in 1999.
This book is written by a famous author in 1999.
questions.answer: This book was written by a famous author in 1999.

questions.question:
Select the correct passive form.
English is spoken all over the world.
options: English is spoken all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English were spoken all over the world.
English are spoken all over the world.
questions.answer: English is spoken all over the world.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the conditional statement?
He said, 'If I had more time, I would learn Spanish.'
options: He said if he had more time, he would learn Spanish.
He said if he had more time, he would have learned Spanish.
He said if he had more time, he would learn Spanish.
He said if he had more time, he will learn Spanish.
questions.answer: He said if he had more time, he would learn Spanish.

questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence with the third conditional.
She said, 'If I had known about the party, I would have gone.'
options: She said if she had known about the party, she would have gone.
She said if she knew about the party, she would have gone.
She said if she had known about the party, she would go.
She said if she had known about the party, she would have gone.
questions.answer: She said if she had known about the party, she would have gone.

questions.question:
Which option correctly uses a discourse marker?
______ Unfortunately, I couldn't attend the meeting yesterday.
options: Actually, unfortunately, I couldn't attend the meeting yesterday.
Anyway, unfortunately, I couldn't attend the meeting yesterday.
Therefore, unfortunately, I couldn't attend the meeting yesterday.
Moreover, unfortunately, I couldn't attend the meeting yesterday.
questions.answer: Anyway, unfortunately, I couldn't attend the meeting yesterday.
